stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the telemetry export merge report task. Analyzed generator telemetry data from two sources (site historian and field operations), performed data cleaning and merging, identified perfect alignment between sources after standardization, discovered linear performance trends, generated 5 visualization figures, and produced a comprehensive quarterly operational performance report with actionable recommendations for management. All deliverables are complete: analysis code in code/, cleaned data in outputs/, and final report with figures in report/.
